Tunis.profile: National political, administrative & commercial capital with 1.05M residents.
Tunis.historical_context: Longstanding concentration of financial institutions, international trade ports, and higher education infrastructure resulting in the lowest regional poverty rate in Tunisia (3.5%).
Tunis.post_2015_drivers: Expansion of commercial services, fintech, digital infrastructure, and suburban transport networks. High nighttime lights radiance reflects steady economic density.
Tunis.sdg_trajectory: On track to eliminate extreme poverty ahead of SDG 1 2030 targets.

Kairouan.profile: Historical & agricultural interior hub with significant rural delegation presence.
Kairouan.historical_context: High historical baseline poverty (34.9% in 2015 survey) due to agricultural dependency, water scarcity, and lower historical capital allocation relative to coastal zones.
Kairouan.post_2015_drivers: Substantial post-2015 rural electrification, deep groundwater irrigation projects, agri-food processing investments, and national social transfer programs driving 10.1 percentage point poverty drop.
Kairouan.sdg_trajectory: Accelerating reduction trajectory required to meet 2030 SDG 1 regional targets.

Kasserine.profile: Interior mountain border region with high rural agriculture & forestry workforce.
Kasserine.historical_context: Structural regional disparity, elevated unemployment in remote delegations (e.g., Hassi El Ferid at 53.5% baseline poverty), and rugged terrain limiting industrial access.
Kasserine.post_2015_drivers: Targeted rural development initiatives, alpha/paper manufacturing rehabilitation, solar energy expansion, and expanded road connections to coastal markets.
Kasserine.sdg_trajectory: High risk of lagging without sustained targeted infrastructure funding.

Sfax.profile: Second largest economic power in Tunisia; major industrial, olive oil & maritime port city.
Sfax.historical_context: Strong entrepreneurial tradition, major chemical phosphate processing, olive oil exports, and fishing industry maintaining low baseline poverty (5.8%).
Sfax.post_2015_drivers: Port modernization, renewable solar projects, expanded agro-processing industrial parks, and strong international export linkages.
Sfax.sdg_trajectory: Strong economic foundation with minimal poverty vulnerability.

Sousse.profile: Major Sahel coastal hub: Tourism capital, university center & textile manufacturing power.
Sousse.historical_context: Diverse economic base combining international beach tourism, mechanical/electrical engineering industries, and high urban infrastructure quality.
Sousse.post_2015_drivers: Post-COVID tourism rebound, expansion of offshore IT services, Enfidha logistics hub growth, and high nighttime lights radiance.
Sousse.sdg_trajectory: Consistently high Human Development Index trajectory.

Le Kef.profile: North-Western mountain border region dominated by cereal & livestock farming.
Le Kef.historical_context: 34.2% INS 2015 baseline poverty reflecting geographical isolation, historical underinvestment in agro-processing, and rainfall dependency.
Le Kef.post_2015_drivers: Cross-border trade agreements, olive & cereal value chain enhancements, and rural healthcare/education access improvements.
Le Kef.sdg_trajectory: Requires accelerated rural electrification & irrigation to meet SDG targets.

Sidi Bouzid.profile: Central Steppe agricultural power producing vegetables, dairy & poultry.
Sidi Bouzid.historical_context: 26.0% baseline poverty; origin site of the 2011 social movements driven by youth unemployment and regional investment disparities.
Sidi Bouzid.post_2015_drivers: Major market infrastructure upgrades (Souk Jedid agrifood hub), solar pumping expansion, and improved highway linkages to coastal ports.
Sidi Bouzid.sdg_trajectory: Steady poverty reduction velocity driven by agricultural modernization.

Gafsa.profile: South-West phosphate mining basin & oasis agriculture ecosystem.
Gafsa.historical_context: 20.8% baseline poverty. Economic fortunes closely tied to Compagnie des Phosphates de Gafsa (CPG) production cycles and employment.
Gafsa.post_2015_drivers: Phosphate transport rehabilitation, growth in solar photovoltaic farms, and economic diversification into oasis date production.
Gafsa.sdg_trajectory: Moderate trajectory dependant on industrial production stability.

Tataouine.profile: Largest southern desert governorate with hydrocarbon services & desert tourism.
Tataouine.historical_context: 17.8% baseline poverty. Low population density with remote desert settlements (Remada, Dehiba) reliant on public employment and cross-border trade.
Tataouine.post_2015_drivers: Nawara natural gas pipeline investments, desert eco-tourism growth, and solar power expansion (El Borma region).
Tataouine.sdg_trajectory: Steady improvement with low overall population exposure.

Bizerte.profile: Northernmost port city: Maritime commerce, metallurgy & agro-industry.
Bizerte.historical_context: 9.8% baseline poverty. Strategic maritime port with established manufacturing base and proximity to Tunis metropolitan economy.
Bizerte.post_2015_drivers: Bizerte smart bridge construction, port expansion, marine biotechnology park, and steady industrial exports.
